digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Friday, July 31, and the day is anchored by Legal Change Management at 10:00 AM, a shifted EPMO EOW check-in at 1:00 PM, the Salesforce/project-pipeline block, and a 3:00 PM overlap between IT Litify Sprint #14 and the Executive Project Status update. I see eight meetings or protected blocks, no active reminders, and seven carried-over items; the top priorities are keeping Court/Phase 2 routing and Amazon Connect inputs moving, using the SMS consent-management update before the project discussion, and deciding coverage for the afternoon overlap. Teams returned only thread previews and SharePoint transcript fetches were rate-limited, so transcript context is limited this morning.
